id.description: The unique id for the audit logs subscription.

date_created.description: The date and time that the subscription was created.

cluster_id.description: The id of the cluster used for object storage.

region.description: Code for the region where the cluster is hosted.

location.description: A description of the location wher ethe cluster is hosted.

label.description: The label used to identify the subscritpion.

sub_status.description: The status of the audit logs subscription.

storage_status.description: The status of the object storage that will be used to store the logs. There may be a delay of about a minute between creating the subscription and the object storage being activated.

s3_hostname.description: The hostname used to connect to object storage.

s3_access_key.description: The read only access key used to connect to object storage.  This value will only be set after storage_status is active.

s3_secret_key.description: The read only secret Key used to connect to object storage.  This value will only be set after storage_status is active.

bucket_name.description: The name of the bucket on object storage, in which the logs will be stored.

prefix.description: The vaue that will be used for the prifix part of the object key of each log file that is stored.

expiration_days.description: The number of days to retain logs before they expire.

retention_gb.description: The average daily retention for the current pay cycle in gb(1024^3).

ingestion_gb.description: The total ingestion for the current pay cycle in gb(1024^3).

retention_gb_price.description: The price per gigabite of disk space used for the billing period.

ingestion_gb_price.description: The price per gigabite of files uploaded during the billig period.

next_invoice_date.description: The end of the current billing period.

charges.description: The expected charges for the current billing period.

storage_used_bytes.description: The current storage usage in bytes.
